newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKOBANK GROUP TO ISSUE FIM 500 MLN BONDS.
newsitem.headline: OKOBANK GROUP TO ISSUE FIM 500 MLN BONDS.

text.p: Finnish cooperative banking group and OKOBANK (Osuuspankkien Keskuspankki Oy OKO) said in a statement on Tuesday they will issue bonds worth 500 million markka in total on November 19.

A 200 million markka three year bond will be issued at a floating issue price and a 4.00 percent coupon. Annual interest will be paid on November 19 and the bond will be fully repaid on November 19, 1999, OKOBANK said.
The bond will be guaranteed by OKOBANK.
In addition, a 300 million markka six-year debenture will be issued at a floating issue price and a 5.25 percent coupon.
The subscription period will run from November 19 to January 20.
